Title: Azure Web Apps Analytics and Azure Network Security Group Analytics available

Body.Content:
These two solutions are now open source and available in the Azure Quickstart Templates gallery: Azure Web Apps Analytics and Azure Network Security Group Analytics.

You can add either of these solutions to your Log Analytics workspace. Then, if you see something you want to change—like a new visualization or an improved query—you can make the change yourself and submit it back to the community.

If you have these solutions installed in your workspace, they will continue working without a change.
